# Admitted Earth descriptors

These are unchanged producer descriptors for the browser's public day/night
defaults. Their exact bytes exercise descriptor admission without a live network
or a mocked digest. No imagery payload is included.

- [Blue Marble July 2004](https://data.foundin.space/textures/earth/blue-marble-200407-500m-mercator-256-v1/dev-20261017-9c0211ef/product.json):
  SHA-256 `5d5fd4f5f3c9302575ec745ea7a81760913e98eb74bac74a6f426338392d56ec`.
- [Black Marble 2016](https://data.foundin.space/textures/earth/black-marble-2016-500m-mercator-256-v1/dev-20261017-27a0cd31/product.json):
  SHA-256 `f3da975a7add498020107e5dc8fbcd87330d61459f8957c32eee635559435bd4`.

Original producer identities, source URLs and processing metadata remain in each
file. These development products are not catalog releases. The broader test suite
uses synthetic bytes to exercise base-image authentication and fallback behavior.
